correctness.rationale: Exact proof in RESULT.md: 2s+3c<=3N/2 and s<=3c force s<=6 on 14-vertex Heawood and s<=9 on 20-vertex Desargues. The possible induced-star counts at extremality are exhausted and uniquely characterized via Fano incidences and subset inclusions. Independently replayed full clique enumeration confirms maxima 6/9, counts 14/20, exact star profiles and orbit transitivity. Computation is entirely finite and does not imply generalization.
